item.title: About This Webpage
item.description:
I always enjoy explaining and discussing concepts to colleagues, and likewise learning about the experiences others have had. It often leads to a better understanding and appreciation of the industry and the dynamics that we all operate in and are a part of.

This site is used to share the results of my learning from various disciplines, ranging from my industry relevant experience to my roles in leadership & socially engaged positions. I hope that as a reader of this site (or prospective employer!) you are able to gain a better understanding of myself and the technologies and projects I use and undertake.

item.title: Learning FreeCAD & Engineering Principles
item.description:
You don’t always want to have to design and fabricate a tool or mechanism to solve a problem. When you do, it’s a journey like no other.

The Case for 3D Printers Link to heading

Instead of shopping for expensive parts or chasing off-the-shelf products that don’t quite meet your needs you can elect to create and manufacture a functional model all within the span of a day, if not hours. However, the knowledge and wisdom that is required to generate a great outcome is hard-won and never immediate.
